role: Planning index; not repository acceptance evidence
dependency_note: Audit may proceed when closeout has only precise owner-only blockers, which remain readiness blockers. No routine work is silently considered complete. Audit findings reopen repair and affected review.
scope: complete maintained fork plus all closeout changes; sampling is triage only
traceability_note: maps_to_fin contains historical labels only. No prior FIN packet or external planning context is required; tasks resolve to the Cxx/Axx/Rxx sections in the packaged documents.

criteria.requirement: Actual main/21.x source, dirty state, capabilities and original/reference identities are recorded without reset or fabricated Git metadata.
Both bundled closures and their limits are verified; accepted-check scope gaps are named, not silently inherited as completed contracts.
Execution-boundary hazards are inspected and corrected before affected tools run.
Source/library/CLI/peer subjects and authority boundaries are explicit and independently attributable.
The four audit and two dependency groups use valid branch-derived finite rosters and real present producers.
Dependency/age/vendor/advisory lookup coverage uses the exact 21.x lock and real source; failed children are not cured by metadata.
Valid complete evidence can pass; wrong-line, stale, absent, unresolved and unauthenticated/expired evidence fails.
A new canonical 21.x closure records real outcomes without borrowed main data or source drift.
All 651 per-line Sass cases and seven blocked CSS fixtures remain accounted for with actual expected/candidate observations.
Each of the six decision families is repaired or supported by exact contract/ownership analysis and required authentic authority.
Scoped exception admission rejects missing, forged, broadened, wrong-line, stale and mutated decisions without changing immutable goldens.
Both line checks have complete assertions or only explicit owner-blocked decisions; no pending case becomes pass by relabeling.
Advertised valid library/runtime/RxJS/compiler/peer and independent CLI minimum configurations actually execute, not just satisfy version arithmetic.
21.x M3 is tested against its packed artifact with real rendered order/nested/lazy/body-overlay and shared-style observations.
The old-workspace migration consumes the exact CLI artifact, the library schematic is packaged, and resulting consumers compile/test on both lines.
Report subjects/rosters are corrected and negatives reject weak workspace/marker/range-only substitutes.
Every original 1697 SHA and 1736 use plus authenticated required cutoff delta is traceable, with no hidden lost/duplicated items.
Material/sensitive/inherited decisions inspect actual hunks, caller/context, both installed floors and meaningful regressions; low-risk batches have exact justified membership.
Contradictions, main-only coverage limits and instrumented-run failures are resolved; current dependency/vendor/advisory and original exception authority are checked.
Technical decisions are evidence-backed and real owner-only blockers explicit; no missing/circular keyword record stands in for security clearance.
Closeout repairs/tests/source and decisions are committed coherently with actual branch-native inputs.
Fresh full runs identify exact subjects and all outcomes; remaining owner-only blockers are not concealed as routine completion.
The complete audit inventory includes the entire maintained fork and all Codex closeout changes.

Audit begins on frozen C05 checkpoints in a fresh context/separate reviewer when available, without preloaded implementation reasoning; otherwise same-agent-explicit and compensating checks are recorded. A green coordinator does not end the assignment.
Every owned family/core/internal helper and changed template/style has contextual source review against its applicable original contract.
Forms, focus/keyboard/accessibility, overlays, defaults, lifecycle/races, data and teardown paths are reviewed across the actual supported scope.
Accidental feature additions, behavior loss and changed historical assumptions are repaired or correctly decided.
Each fix has meaningful regression evidence and review of the repair on both affected lines.
Every primary/testing declaration and type/value/provider identity obligation is independently reconciled, including inherited/protected/generic/overload behavior.
All API extras/removals/allowlists, alias/version semantics and changed deprecation notices receive exact review.
Authored source/packed/member/testing/Sass dependencies are semantically scanned and checked at real floors without private/deprecated loopholes.
Strict consumer/subclass/DI and deliberately broken export/type/private/engine cases demonstrate actual detection.
All 57 original paths and transitive shared cases are authenticated and reconciled to actual product/control/shared execution identities.
All test adapters/shims/rewrites/skips and expected-output derivation are reviewed; candidate-derived oracles and assertion weakening are rejected.
Resolved build inputs prove artifact-mode execution cannot fall back to workspace/current upstream implementation.
Excluded original cases, zero discovery, duplicate IDs, plain-helper leakage and independent failing observations are explicitly tested/dispositioned.
Full exported/configurable Sass/value/API/aggregate/owned CSS obligations and all closeout decisions are independently reviewed.
Every companion dimension/state uses independent exact peer M2 expectations and real consumed computed properties/overlays on both lines.
Packed M3 order/nested/lazy/body/shared-style scope and owned-only isolation are fully audited, not marker-only.
Wrong/missing/borrowed oracle, hidden dependency, bad token/value/host and mutated historical expected output are detected.

tasks.title: Browser, native motion and server behavior

criteria.requirement: All required family/engine/runtime/state identities are reconciled to actual instantiated assertions with explicit valid applicability.
Browser launch/tool/cache/process/fixture controls and genuine zoneless/user-driven update paths are reviewed.
Enabled/disabled/reduced/interrupted/destroyed motion and exactly-once/no-leak guarantees have meaningful positive/negative tests.
CSP enforcement, nonce/negative dynamic styles, sanitization/DOM boundaries and browser-global-free SSR are audited without unproven Safari/hydration claims.
Both exact packaged frontends and support-file identities execute the supported old-workspace/resulting-consumer workflows.
Transformation/parser behavior preserves supported syntax and unrelated data/providers with precise refusal diagnostics.
Transactions, concurrent edits, partial write recovery, symlink/path bounds and CLI error exits are tested without destructive rollback.
Frontend parity, packaging/runtime floor and artifact-source matching survive adversarial mutation tests.
Every ledger/use/dependency item and material existing/closeout decision is audited, not only remaining questions or a sample.
Actual installed-floor/owned-source reasoning, batches, coverage observations and contradictory evidence are independently checked.
Current primary advisories, build/CLI/vendor closure, provenance/license and realistic untrusted-input exposure are reviewed.
All exceptions have authentic authority/scope/expiry behavior; no unresolved mandatory security question is falsely cleared.
Complete expected-to-assertion-to-admission flow and all report/oracle/producer schemas are reviewed, including FIN-01 and Codex changes.
Real negatives cover vacuous/omitted/stale/failed/forged/borrowed evidence and wrong source/artifact/line subjects.
Pack timing, runtime resolution, output confinement, rehash/seal/archive transport and trusted-writer assumptions are validated.
Shipped package contents/metadata/licenses/maps/scripts are correct, minimal and free of private or unintended tool dependencies.

tasks.title: Chainman, CI, floors and line independence

criteria.requirement: Current bootstrap/pins/readiness/config/commands/hooks/process/cache/workflow permissions and trust boundary receive full review.
Clean canonical runs use qualified tools and isolated outputs, without broad source exclusions or ambient-tool/secret leakage.
Advertised runtime/RxJS/compiler/peer and CLI floor configurations actually execute with justified cross-product scope.
Both real source lines have independently tested artifacts and reviewed context; shared file hashes do not substitute for branch verification.
Public/maintainer docs, examples, versions, provenance/license and limitations match real support and authority.

Dead/duplicate/complex glue is assessed for reliable AI-assisted maintenance of the frozen surface, preserving useful Chainman reproducibility rather than optimizing for hypothetical contributor familiarity; no unreviewed stylistic churn or loss of evidence.
Every audited file/contract item and finding/decision is reconciled; every closeout/audit repair is re-reviewed.
No unread required domain, unresolved mandatory defect or false publication/production claim remains hidden in a summary.
All audit findings have reviewed fixes or legitimate scoped nonblocking/owner-blocked dispositions.
Final library/CLI version/source/content identities and metadata are unambiguous across both lines.
Required tests/oracles/decisions/docs/locks are committed before the trusted final execution.
Any changed reviewed inputs invalidate dependent evidence and review instead of receiving a restamped receipt.
Fresh canonical clean artifacts execute every applicable positive/negative contract with correct source/line/library/CLI/tool/oracle identities.
Every required report/case/decision and current advisory/age/authority state is validated; no unknown or pending mandatory item passes.
The complete evidence set is rehashed/sealed and survives move/tamper/wrong-line/stale-evidence negatives under the documented trust model.
Durable immutable archives and a release-set index join two independent line manifests with no circular hash or source-receipt reattribution.
Final report reconciles full file/contract audit coverage, G01-G13, findings, repairs, review methods, exceptions and exact reproduction inputs.
Readiness or blocked status precisely reflects mandatory evidence/authority; no percentage, checker count or same-agent reread claims external certification.
Owner publication/version/tag and private Cyph qualification/rollback/observation operations are prepared but separately authorized.
The delivered candidate has no known undisclosed routine work; any remaining blocker or future-maintenance follow-up is explicit and scoped.
